fieldValues.title: Review and merge
fieldValues.theory: A group PR merges when its quorum is met: a builder and a different reviewer agree, and the gates are green, within the cycle's budget and while the group is not paused. Anything beyond the mandate escalates.
fieldValues.practice:
- The reviewer posts the `<!-- wg-quorum -->` comment and adds `gate:auto-merge` (`routines/wg-reviewer.md`). It assents to a builder's decision and never ratifies it; the group's session at cycle close does (decision 70a05a5c).
- `pr-upkeep` checks the quorum every 15 minutes and merges.
- PRs outside any group follow their gate label: `gate:auto-merge` or `gate:owner-merge`.
gaps: Every agent posts as the owner's GitHub account, so builder and reviewer identities are stated by the routines, not proven by GitHub.
fieldValues.test: Stage 13: 5 passing. The todo about the reviewer ratifying is out of date (decision 70a05a5c settled it) and should be replaced.
